title: Variable Catch Basics
subtitle: Catch the tokens and build simple Java variable declarations.
objective: Collect the correct code parts, avoid hazards, and arrange each Java variable statement in the right order.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid integer variable declaration for score.
hints: Start with the data type keyword.
The variable name comes before the equals sign.
A Java statement ends with a semicolon.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid String variable declaration for name.
hints: String text values are wrapped in quotation marks.
The identifier should describe what the value stores.
Keep the declaration in type-name-equals-value order.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid boolean variable declaration for isReady.
hints: Boolean variables store only true or false.
Do not put true inside quotation marks.
Use a descriptive variable name after the type.
